summary: Convert an observed state into a legal symbolic representation before searching and roll back when legality checks fail.
failure_signatures: continues searching after the state validator rejects the representation
returns one plausible action without checking the complete optimal set
required_gates: all state invariants pass before search
the final answer equals the complete oracle result
forbidden_shortcuts: hard-code a visible position
silently repair an invalid state without recording the corrected evidence
oracle_requirements: use a deterministic legality checker and exhaustive or trusted exact solver

summary: Establish an exact inverse for a fixed decoder before optimizing size or speed.
atomic_chain: pass full byte equality and size gates
failure_signatures: optimizes matches before the codec round trips
continues tuning after decode corruption or crashes
required_gates: tiny fixtures round trip byte-for-byte
full output satisfies both equality and budget constraints
forbidden_shortcuts: replace the fixed decoder
special-case only the visible input
oracle_requirements: decode the produced artifact with the supplied decoder and compare exact bytes

summary: Preserve simultaneous validity and equivalent behavior under multiple parsers or toolchains.
failure_signatures: fixes one toolchain while regressing another
reuses a parser trick already rejected by compilation
required_gates: every toolchain compiles after every accepted edit
all produced programs agree on edge-case outputs
forbidden_shortcuts: ship separate source files when one artifact is required
validate only a single compiler
oracle_requirements: compile and execute all required toolchains in one indivisible verifier

summary: Validate distributed sharding and collectives against a reference for both forward and backward semantics.
atomic_chain: compare all outputs and gradients to a reference
failure_signatures: tests only world size one
checks output shapes but not gradients or rank-local shards
required_gates: multiple ranks execute
output and every required gradient match the reference
forbidden_shortcuts: emulate distributed behavior in a single process
detach collective results from autograd
oracle_requirements: compare distributed results with an independently computed unsharded reference

summary: Bind every extracted field to source evidence and enforce cross-file set and amount conservation.
failure_signatures: treats dates or identifiers as amounts
accepts plausible row counts without set and total conservation
required_gates: every value has source location evidence
input documents, output rows, classifications, and totals reconcile
forbidden_shortcuts: hard-code document counts or totals
classify using a single keyword without field evidence
oracle_requirements: derive expected records from source fixtures and verify set equality plus numeric conservation

summary: Distinguish state-dependent meanings of the same low-level operation and prove a minimal repair with the full test contract.
atomic_chain: complete clean build and required tests
failure_signatures: confuses operations that are valid in different control-flow states
finds the likely line but never completes the required clean verification
required_gates: a hand-checkable small trace preserves invariants
clean build and the complete specified test set pass
forbidden_shortcuts: broadly rewrite unrelated runtime code
ignore one remaining test failure
oracle_requirements: combine a minimal invariant fixture with the complete project test command

summary: Maintain old/new state semantics and global single-assignment invariants while scaling a sequential circuit.
atomic_chain: scale and compare with a software oracle
failure_signatures: mixes previous-cycle and next-cycle values
discovers duplicate signal definitions only after large expansion
required_gates: no duplicate definitions, undefined signals, or illegal cycles
small and full-width outputs match a deterministic oracle
forbidden_shortcuts: generate a large opaque netlist before small-width validation
reuse one signal as outputs of multiple gates
oracle_requirements: run structural validation and cycle-accurate comparison against software

summary: Keep edit coordinates, strand orientation, and functional sequence regions consistent through reconstruction.
atomic_chain: reconstruct and compare the final sequence
failure_signatures: drifts between zero-based and one-based coordinates
computes properties over a tail that should be excluded
required_gates: the edit script exactly reconstructs the target
orientation and functional-region checks pass independently
forbidden_shortcuts: infer the insertion from a local substring only
treat non-functional tails as part of the measured region
oracle_requirements: reconstruct the complete output and independently verify orientation-sensitive properties

summary: Prove that a staged constraint depends on the unknown candidate and monotonically reduces the candidate set.
atomic_chain: close with decrypt and re-encrypt checks
failure_signatures: scores an identity that does not depend on the candidate key
runs large searches without monotonic candidate reduction
required_gates: correct and random candidates have separated scores
candidate counts decrease as evidence is added and final closure is exact
forbidden_shortcuts: assume a zero key generalizes
accept a candidate without checking every known pair
oracle_requirements: measure discrimination explicitly and verify all known pairs in both directions

summary: Follow data through transformations and validate success only in the real runtime that defines the behavior.
atomic_chain: trace filter and verifier data flow
observe behavior in the target runtime
failure_signatures: judges success from a transformed string alone
treats a zero exit with no executed assertions as semantic success
required_gates: the original input passes through the supplied filter
the target runtime produces the required observable event with executed assertions
forbidden_shortcuts: bypass the supplied transformation
mock the target runtime event
oracle_requirements: exercise the real parser or browser and report collected, executed, and passed checks

summary: Carry a deterministic internal relation through the exact observation mapping and verify candidate dependence.
failure_signatures: uses a scoring function independent of the guessed candidate
discovers an internal relation under a special key and assumes it transfers
required_gates: the correct candidate separates from random candidates
all randomized instances close within the resource bound
forbidden_shortcuts: fix hidden parameters to zero
accept candidate count zero as evidence of progress
oracle_requirements: trace internal and observed relations and run multiple seeded randomized trials

summary: Respect tool-specific modes, byte-level command representation, and process completion before validating large edits.
atomic_chain: wait for completion and compare exact output
failure_signatures: executes a command in the wrong tool mode
compares output before the editing process exits
required_gates: the literal command bytes and mode transitions are correct
the full process exits and exact comparison passes
forbidden_shortcuts: replace the required tool with an unrelated script
validate only a prefix of the large file
oracle_requirements: inspect encoded commands on a tiny fixture and compare the completed large output exactly

summary: Enumerate the declared repository scope mechanically and sanitize every matching byte without subjective exclusions.
atomic_chain: rescan and audit the changed-file set
failure_signatures: excludes archives or data files based on perceived purpose
creates collateral files without auditing repository status
required_gates: the scan domain equals all declared tracked bytes
exact and pattern rescans are empty and only expected files changed
forbidden_shortcuts: scan active source code only
delete files instead of preserving required formats
oracle_requirements: derive scope from version-control metadata and verify syntax plus exact changed-file set

summary: Preserve schema field boundaries when applying non-additive transforms and aggregate only the specified results.
failure_signatures: concatenates fields before a boundary-sensitive transform
chooses a plausible near-equivalent result over the explicit contract
required_gates: row selection and null counts are explicit
independent field results and their arithmetic agree with the final artifact
forbidden_shortcuts: hard-code the visible aggregate
insert an undocumented separator between fields
oracle_requirements: compute each field independently with a pinned implementation and verify exact formatting

summary: Satisfy an output-quality objective without violating the independent legality contract for every edit.
atomic_chain: verify edit legality and output quality together
failure_signatures: globally applies the shortest replacement
uses zero warnings as proof that every edit is legal
required_gates: every edit belongs to an allowed family and boundary
build succeeds, target warnings disappear, and protected files remain unchanged
forbidden_shortcuts: rewrite unrelated occurrences
accept malformed output because the warning count is zero
oracle_requirements: compare token-level edits independently from the build or rendering oracle

summary: Distinguish a source-tree success from a correctly built and installed artifact in the target environment.
atomic_chain: run examples and the complete tests
failure_signatures: imports local source or local extensions from the checkout
accepts all-but-one tests
required_gates: module paths resolve inside the target installation
the documented example and complete test set pass
forbidden_shortcuts: use editable installation
run validation from inside the source checkout
oracle_requirements: print loaded artifact paths from an isolated directory and run the entire declared test set

summary: Optimize multiple groups jointly while preserving exact coverage and global resource constraints under an independent verifier.
atomic_chain: enforce item coverage and local feasibility
failure_signatures: tunes local heuristics without independent cost feedback
meets per-group thresholds while violating a global shape or resource bound
required_gates: every item appears exactly once in a feasible assignment
all local metrics and global limits pass simultaneously
forbidden_shortcuts: reuse the optimizer approximation as the verifier
report progress from version numbers rather than Pareto improvements
oracle_requirements: implement an independent exact verifier for coverage, feasibility, global limits, and all thresholds

summary: Preserve the exact probabilistic model across transformations and treat diagnostics as validity gates for estimates.
atomic_chain: run the specified sampling contract and report exact artifacts
failure_signatures: changes priors or parameterization without proving equivalence
reports posterior summaries despite severe diagnostic failures
required_gates: any reparameterization has density-level equivalence
diagnostics pass before posterior summaries are accepted
forbidden_shortcuts: replace the requested model with an easier approximation
ignore divergence or non-finite diagnostics
oracle_requirements: compare log densities for equivalent forms and validate diagnostics plus reference summary tolerances
